heroSub: Hand-painted originals inspired by Australian native flora, made one canvas at a time on the Redcliffe Peninsula.
statement: Inspired by Australia's native flora, I paint atmospheric botanical artworks using layered colour and translucent depth. Each original is created to capture a feeling rather than a perfect representation of nature.
galleryIntro: Each painting is a one-off original. Tap any piece to see it up close.
upcomingIntro: Pieces currently on the easel. Join the early access list to see them before they're listed.
aboutBody: I'm a graphic designer by trade and a painter by instinct, working from the Redcliffe Peninsula in Queensland. Every background is built up in layers rather than painted flat — a dark base, a mid glaze, then a light pass over the top — which is what gives each piece its depth. The botanicals go on afterwards: fine white contour lines, stippled texture, and native flora drawn from the real plant.
aboutBody2: Every original comes with a signed Certificate of Authenticity. All copyrights and reproductions are reserved for the artist.
earlyAccessBody: New paintings go to this list before they're listed anywhere else, with first pick before a piece goes public.
earlyAccessNote: No spam. Just new work and the occasional studio note.
contactBody: Whether you're asking about an available painting, thinking about a commission, or just want to see what's coming next — I'd love to hear from you.
contactDeliveryNote: Local delivery available on the Redcliffe Peninsula
